card.name: "in patients" after NSAID avoid-use
card.fires_on: The word "in" right after a named NSAID in the heart failure warning "Avoid use of X in patients with severe heart failure". It also fires on "patients" after "avoided in" or "given with care to".

modes.label: Heart failure warning
modes.description: "in" following an NSAID product name in the "Avoid use of ... in patients with severe heart failure" line.

modes.label: Patients after caution phrase
modes.description: "patients" after "avoided in" or "given with care to" in NSAID cautions.
modes.example: Naproxen and esomeprazole magnesium delayed-release tablets should be avoided in<< patients>> with severe hepatic impairment

card.plain: It marks the spot in NSAID warnings where the text says which patients should avoid the drug.
